title: Ads Operations Associate
subtitle: Job summary
body:
# Job summary

We're looking for a passionate and results-oriented Advertising Operations Associate to join our growing eCommerce team. You will play a key role in advertising account management (especially Facebook ads). The ideal candidate will be an individual with knowledge of advertising accounts, mindset about building products on e-commerce platforms, as well as the one with a keen eye for detail.

# Essential Roles and Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with the Marketing team, manage and operate advertising accounts on social media platforms (like Facebook, Amazon,...)

- Oversee campaign creation across platforms, monitor ads account performance and troubleshoot any issues that may arise.

- Collaborate with agencies managing Facebook Ads to ensure optimal campaign performance.

- Manage resources (especially meta) for the company.

- Support monitoring campaign progress, effective management & reporting to Line Manager.

# Skills and Qualifications:

- More than 1 year of experience in ad operations or a related field (especially Facebook ads).

- Have Digital Advertising knowledge - experience with running ad campaigns on digital platforms.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, as well as great attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Effective communication and collaboration skills with team members.

- Proactive learning behavior. We request all people to learn daily (only learn things that can support your work immediately) and share it with others.

- A positive, “can do” attitude.

# Come join PATI, you will have a chance to enjoy

- Salary: 7.000.000 - 9.000.000 VND/month + incentive based on performance (negotiate).

- Opportunity to work in a fast-growing E-commerce business.

- A Dynamic, Professional and Friendly Working Environment with the purpose of connecting people.

- To fully enjoy other social welfare regimes such as: social insurance, statutory leave,...

- Joining various team bonding activities.

We are looking for someone who shares our passion for wellness, our commitment to excellence. If you believe you have the skills and mindset to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you.

Company Address: 152 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 25, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh city

**🚀 APPLY [HERE](https://paticreativeagency.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrusjCC2CJeEWBc1wNKIX7fibc)**
